name: Carrion Defense Works NBC Threat Assessment Kit NTAK-2
product_name: Carrion Defense Works NBC Threat Assessment Kit NTAK-2
description: A portable nuclear, biological, and chemical threat assessment system contained in a hardened case the size of a large lunchbox. The NTAK-2 includes a radiation dosimeter, biological agent sampler with rapid gene-sequencing chip, chemical compound mass spectrometer, and an AI analysis module that cross-references detected threats against Carrion's comprehensive threat database. The system can identify a biological agent, assess radiation exposure levels, or categorize an unknown chemical compound in under 90 seconds. Carrion issues the NTAK-2 to their field teams and sells it to corporate emergency response units.

specifications.info: beta; gamma; neutron; 90-second identification; 4; 000+ compound database; surface swab; and liquid

story_hooks: An NTAK-2 deployed at a public event detected a biological agent that does not exist in any database — the AI flagged it as engineered but could not identify its function, and the concentration is increasing.

Carrion's threat database updates are being delayed for non-Carrion customers, meaning corporate response teams are operating with outdated threat data while Carrion's own teams have current information.

physical_description.visual_profile: A ruggedized tactical assessment unit resembling a high-end equipment case crossed with medical diagnostics hardware. Compact, angular, military-grade aesthetic with integrated sampling ports and a recessed touchscreen interface. Designed for rapid field deployment by hazmat and corporate security teams.
physical_description.dimensions: 38cm wide × 26cm deep × 16cm tall (briefcase-sized, slightly larger than a lunchbox)
physical_description.weight_description: 3.8kg total — handheld but requires two-handed carry for extended periods; fits in vehicle equipment racks with carrying handles
physical_description.primary_material: Carbon-composite reinforced polymer housing with internal aluminum chassis and impact-resistant polycarbonate sensor covers
physical_description.finish: Matte tactical black with rubberized grip zones; brushed metal accents around sensor arrays; textured non-slip base panels
physical_description.color_scheme: Dominant matte black with chrome-silver sensor module faces; safety-orange markings on hazmat sampling ports; Carrion Defense Works crimson logo stripe along top edge
physical_description.interface_elements: 5-inch recessed tactical display (dimmable for low-light ops), three-button interface cluster (SAMPLE/ANALYZE/PURGE), atmospheric intake grille with magnetic cap, contact swab port (spring-loaded), liquid sample inlet with sealed cap, micro-USB charging port, status LED indicator array (green/yellow/red threat warnings)
distinctive_features: Modular sensor cartridge visible through polycarbonate window — stacked microfluidic and spectral analysis chips glowing faintly during analysis cycles
Magnetic quick-release sampling heads (removable for field replacement)
Integrated UV-reactive compound detection window that illuminates during chemical analysis
Threat database status display showing last update timestamp and current active threat count
Biometric lock pad below screen (fingerprint/retinal scanner) — Tier 2+ security feature
Faint blue status glow when powered, transitioning to red during active threat detection
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Carrion Defense Works logo and 'NTAK-2' designation on top panel; serial number plaque; regulatory compliance stamps (GLMZ certified, corpo-grade hazmat rated); threat level classification chart etched on interior lid
physical_description.condition_typical: In field use: surrounded by protective equipment, often mounted on tactical vests or vehicle dashboards; screen shows active threat analysis with real-time compound matching; occasional condensation on lens covers in humid environments
